name: Café de Miroir ~Tadaima Junbichuu!~
original_name: Café de MIROIR～ただいま準備中！～
source:
You're a run-of-the-mill employee at a restaurant like any other. One day, you're notified of your transfer to Café de Miroir in Akihabara. Miroir's waitresses are all cute in their own way, not to mention just how much charm their frilly uniforms add. But don't forget that Akihabara is a geek's paradise! Your customers are going to be... unique, to say the least. How will you fare as the cafe's manager? And what will your relationship with each of the waitresses be like?

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20020110161226fw_/http://www.circles.ne.jp/~sugarpink/game/miro_main.htm]official website[/url]]
